purpose: Resolve whether one represented authority grant authorizes one represented action context at an explicit evaluation time without inferring authority from identity, capability, history, credential possession, restore, or copying.

AuthorityGrant.scope_rule: Each grant scope list is non-empty. '*' is the explicit broad-scope token; omission is not universal authority.
AuthorityGrant.epoch_rule: A query need not carry grantee_epoch when the selected grant explicitly uses grantee_epoch_scopes=['*']. A narrower epoch-scoped grant requires epoch context at resolution time; missing context is UNRESOLVED, not invented denial or authority.
AuthorityGrant.credential_binding: credential_ref is optional identity binding only and does not prove credential validity.
AuthorityGrant.renewal: A renewed grant uses a new grant_id and may name supersedes_grant_ref. Renewal never mutates an expired grant into current authority by inference.

AuthorityQuery.conditional: authority_ref is required when authority_required=true. grantee_epoch becomes decision-relevant only when the selected grant is epoch-scoped. credential_ref is required only when the selected grant binds one.

decision_rules.property: non-authority-bearing action does not require a ceremonial lease
authority-required action names the grant it relies on

decision_rules.decision: eval_time before valid_from or after expires_at -> NOT_AUTHORIZED

decision_rules.property: grantee and represented scopes must match
decision_rules.decision: grantee/action/subject/task/Host mismatch -> NOT_AUTHORIZED unless the corresponding grant scope explicitly contains '*'

decision_rules.property: credential identity binding does not equal credential validity
decision_rules.decision: if grant credential_ref is represented, query credential_ref must match; external credential validity remains out of scope

decision_rules.property: renewal does not resurrect old authority
decision_rules.decision: supersedes_grant_ref is provenance only; resolver evaluates only query.authority_ref

decision_rules.property: copying/restoring grant bytes does not widen an explicit epoch boundary
decision_rules.decision: narrow epoch scope requires matching epoch; missing epoch context -> UNRESOLVED; explicit '*' permits Hosts with no epoch mechanism

verification_boundary: represented grant/query consistency and time/scope resolution only; no external mandate, credential, world-policy, caller-classification, or universal epoch-mechanism truth claim
